Diagonalization of the centered linear and quadratic intensity modes with nonzero eigenvalues \(N\) and \(2(N-1)\).

claim_to_evidence.domain: Integers \(a,b\ge1\), \(N=a+b\ge4\), \(1\le k<N\), homogeneous rate-one symmetric exclusion on K_{a,b}, uniform stationary start, all successful hops counted.
unproved_limits: Does not derive third or higher count cumulants or full count law away from exact Poisson cases.
Does not prove Poisson convergence of the entire count process when F tends to one.
No independent proof audit or exhaustive literature uniqueness certificate.

correctness.rationale: The complete-bipartite fixed-particle Markov chain is reversible under the uniform configuration measure. Lumping onto occupancy J gives exact u_j and d_j, whose quadratic escape rate splits into exactly two orthogonal hypergeometric modes with relaxation rates \(N\) and \(2(N-1)\). The tilted-generator Poisson identity gives the second count cumulant, and factorial-moment formulas through degree four produce the displayed positive two-term rational ratio. Denominators are nonzero for \(N\ge4\). The Poisson equality cases and joint \(N^{-1/4}\) expansion follow by direct algebra. The embedded verification code passed 59 independently rebuilt full-state exact rational Poisson-equation comparisons and symbolic all-parameter fourth-moment factorization; finite tests support but do not replace the analytical proof.

originality.rationale: The full relevant model/spectrum treatment by Mendonça develops the un-tilted generator, eigenvalues, and stationary vectors, but not the exact long-time count of all successful hops or its quartic joint-balance scaling. Stinchcombe--de Queiroz define a different instantaneous activity variable on directed one-dimensional TASEP; this is not an integrated jump count. The exact nonnegative two-mode rational expression, its Poisson equality cases and joint \(N^{-1/4}\) window were not identified in inspected sources or targeted semantic record searches. Broader Hahn-polynomial/full-counting-statistics deductions remain a residual originality risk; no novelty is inferred from absence of search hits alone.

value.rationale: For exclusion gas transport on dense bipartite networks, total jump-count fluctuations are a meaningful kinetic observable not determined by stationary density or ordinary relaxation spectrum alone. This all-size exact law resolves a complete Poisson-vs-overdispersed classification and identifies a two-channel cancellation boundary with an explicit finite-size \(N^{-1/4}\) joint scaling. It gives a natural universality/crossover fact instead of an arbitrary low-dimensional instance, while not claiming a general current large-deviation theorem.
